cpu.reason: CPU-time or CPU-utilization metrics are present.

energy.reason: No measured energy in joules is present; CPU time and estimated power are not energy measurements.

filesystem.reason: Storage experiment includes actual allocated/filesystem byte measurements.

memory_pressure.reason: Memory-pressure experiment records an enforced limit or pressure configuration.

native_finality.reason: Native finality and sharded-consensus integration are absent. Ethereum RPC JSON replay is an ingestion/verification adapter, not native finality validation or consensus integration.

presentation.reason: This run provides machine-readable tables, escaped LaTeX and an offline report; manuscript revision and reviewer acceptance are not assessed.

real_data.reason: Real-data measurements record source metadata and an input hash.

real_pi_platform.reason: No successful measurement is backed by a Raspberry Pi system device model; a platform label or desktop smoke run is insufficient.

remote_tcp.reason: No successful TCP measurement records distinct client/server hostnames or device IDs; loopback does not establish a remote deployment.

repository_metadata.reason: Run metadata records a code version and configuration; public repository availability is not verified.

service_disconnect.reason: No observed service-disconnection test on distinct TCP hosts is present; in-process fault injection does not establish this evidence.

storage_accounting.reason: Verifier and provider byte accounting is available.
